issue_context.title: Metadata of immutable secrets cannot be changed when the `.data` has a key with empty value
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

I have created the following secret in my cluster.

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: test
immutable: true
data:
  "foo": ""
  "one": dHdvCg==
```

When I add labels to my secret and try to apply it in the cluster I get the following error 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: test
  labels:
    "foo": "bar"
immutable: true
data:
  "foo": ""
  "one": dHdvCg==

```

```bash
$ k apply -f secret.yaml
The Secret "test" is invalid: data: Forbidden: field is immutable when `immutable` is set
```

This also happens when I use `kubectl edit` or using the `controller-runtime` go client.

Not sure why, but `kubectl label` works.
```bash
$ k label secret test foo=bar
secret/test labeled
```

### What did you expect to happen?

I expect that the secret can be updated with the new labels since the `data` is not actually changed.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Steps explained above.

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
